Loganberry Infused Vodka Martini
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Sunday, December 20, 2009 - 11:05pm

Ingredients




1 (25 oz) bottle vodka
1 pint Loganberries, plus some for garnish
6 ounces Cointreau

Preparation

1 Pour 1 bottle of vodka into a jar and add 1 pint of fresh Loganberries. Let stand for 3 days. 2 Into a martini shaker, add 2 ounces Loganberry infused vodka, 1/2 ounce Cointreau and ice. Shake, then strain into martini glass. Garnish with Loganberries.
